subject: Sorry about the reservation
text:
Hi Sam,

I wanted to apologize properly for yesterday's mix-up with the dinner reservation. I should have double-checked the confirmation before sharing the details with the rest of the group. It was frustrating for everyone, and I understand that you had to rearrange your plans at the last minute. I feel terrible about that.

Thank you for staying calm and for suggesting that we ask the restaurant if it could keep the original table under a different name. That was a really helpful suggestion, and it made the situation much easier to fix. I also appreciate you offering to contact your friend's catering service when the first option fell through.

I have already sent a note to the restaurant, explaining what happened and asking them to hold the space until seven thirty. I will also check whether they can provide a written update this afternoon. If they cannot, I will call them personally before we meet near the station.

Again, I am sorry for the confusion. I value your time and your patience. I hope the evening still works for everyone, and I would be glad to help with transportation or seating arrangements.

Please let me know if you would rather move the meal to Saturday evening instead. I am happy to pay for the revised booking or cover any small change fee. I know plans matter, and I do not want this to become a habit. Thank you for your grace and your good humor throughout.

Warm regards,
Jordan
